transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed and sad, and it's been going on for nearly a year now. I just feel so down all the time, and I can't seem to shake this heavy feeling.
Have you had this depressed mood most days for at least two years, or has it been closer to one year?
It has definitely been closer to one year. To be exact, I've been feeling this way for about 11 months now. It hasn't really let up at all during this time.
